note: Declared HS 381190 is supported by an actual customs line, but as an IMPORT, not an export: '2024-10-18 | BINZHOU ZHIYUAN TRADING CO.LTD | SUVIRA ENERGY | VISCOSITY REDUCER ... (END USE OIL INDIA LTD.) | CHINA | NHAVA SHEVA SEA, India | HS 38119000 | BOL 6199679'. So the company does trade in the declared HS 381190 (viscosity reducer / fuel-additive chemistry) but the recorded flow is inbound from China for end-use by Oil India Ltd. The only confirmed outbound shipment is a re-export of exhibition samples (HS 90230090) to Russia, i.e. not a commercial export of 381190. Export status is therefore 'confirmed' only in the narrow sense that outbound customs movements exist with date, destination, HS and BOL; no commercial export of the declared HS was found.
